'''Artificial intelligence''' was the term for intelligence in a manufactured rather than evolved or genetically engineered being. Degrees of sophistication ran from simple [[Computer/Legends|computer]] programs to artificial [[Sentience programming|sentience]].

Advanced artificial intelligence could be found in many computers, such as a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] main computer, but was usually installed in a [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. Droid intelligence levels defined which of several degrees they fell under.

Droids were typically programmed with certain restraints in their artificial intelligence, which limited what actions they could take to fulfill their objectives. For instance, most droids possessed deeply embedded [[life preservation programming]] preventing them from harming a sentient. Even [[Class four droid/Legends|fourth degree droids]] possessed such programming, modified after the fact to allow specific targets, such as enemy troops, assassination targets, or captives to be interrogated.
